column1: # Super Mario Bros. Wonder (010015100B514000), update 1.2.1: Nintendo's sead / agl / gsys engine on NVN.
# Tested 2026-10-29 on the Legion Y700 (TB322FC, Snapdragon 8 Elite, Adreno 830, Android 16), driven with DM_CTL: the title, a new save (one player, Luigi), the prologue level
# (dialogue, running, jumping, coins, the goal), the Bowser cutscene, the flag-pole level's start and the world map after a restart from the save. About 1.1-1.35 GB footprint; no audio underrun.
# Frame rate (2026-10-29, docked, first level, walking right with jumps): 60 fps; replay 5.3-5.7 ms and GPU 8.2-8.9 ms a frame, frame work p90 10-11 ms. The game runs sead's dynamic
# interval (main+0xcfd24): after a frame whose main-loop span ran long it presents the next at interval 2 (33.3 ms). Before the core's pool lookup search, UBWC by default and the
# adaptive rate judging frames against the game's own hold, it did that ~53 times in 20 s (replay 7.1-7.5 + GPU 11.2-11.9 ms; its fence wait made them one after the other) and

# the rate stepped down to 40; now about once in 20 s of play (the two runs had different inputs: dashing then, walking now). Loads (a restart after losing a life) still bring runs of interval-2 frames, from the game's own work.
# What it needed from the core: CPU-written linear render-target textures copied from their storage (its sky's four 64x1 RGBA16F gradients: without it diagonal bands of
# saturated colour over every level). The one red log line: its title logs "SetRenderEnableConditional: the host draws anyway"; render_cond on changed nothing seen, so it is left off.
# The shader tables were split on Windows (/ paths since d1ad5f2), with the same 16,268 keys as upstream's. Not tested yet: later worlds, Wonder effects, multiplayer.
# Button icons in the game's text (Press L+R, A Select, B Back, + Delete Save Data) come from the Nintendo extension shared font: the porter's data pack ships make_ext_font.py's
# stand-in (nintendo_ext.ttf, DM_SHARED_FONT_EXT) since 2026-10-29; before, they drew as '?'

# Galaxy Z Fold7 (Adreno 830, base game v0), world map, no GPU turbo: with the ADPF session (GPU time reported) the KGSL governor held
# the GPU at 160 MHz, its lowest clock, and frames took ~20 ms of GPU time (122 of 300 dropped at a held 60). Without ADPF it chose 222-443 MHz (GPU ~10 ms,
# 11 of 300 dropped handheld; docked 342 MHz, 16 of 300). The adaptive rate made a loop of its own: stepped to 30 fps the GPU idles, the governor stays at
# 160 MHz and 60 never fits again, so the rate is held at the game's 60. That was enough for the map but not for a course (31-115 of 300 dropped, GPU
# 12-19 ms), so the GPU goes to its highest clock while frames miss the display (perf_android.c turbo_auto).
# Opt-in for devices like the Fold7, not a default (the Legion Y700 holds 60 fps on 1.2.1 with ADPF and the adaptive rate, and weaker devices need the 40/30
# steps): put these three lines in the app's env.txt (Android/data/org.nx2a.supermariobroswonder/files/env.txt).
#   DM_NO_ADPF=1
#   DM_ADAPTIVE_FPS=0
#   DM_GPU_TURBO=auto
